      Accessibility

       

      Website Accessibility Statement

      Glossier has an ongoing commitment to achieving the highest levels of satisfaction for all customers.  As part of these efforts, Glossier is dedicated to offering a quality online experience on www.glossier.com (the "Website") to customers with disabilities that is full and equal to the experience provided to customers without disabilities.

      To assist in achieving the aforementioned accessibility goals with respect to the Website, Glossier has committed to the Website being designed, developed, and operated in substantial conformance with generally-recognized and accepted guidelines and/or standards for website accessibility (the "Standards"). While these Standards may change and/or evolve over time, they are currently the World Wide Web Consortium’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 at Levels A and AA ("WCAG").

      Working with experienced accessibility consultants, Glossier is taking the steps necessary to achieve substantial conformance with WCAG. Glossier is providing training to necessary individuals on an ongoing basis regarding accessible website design and maintenance. Furthermore, our Website will continue to be assessed on a recurring basis from both an engineering and user-experience basis, including the use of assistive technology (such as screen readers and screen magnifiers).

      Contact Glossier with Your Accessibility Questions/Feedback

      Please be aware that our efforts are ongoing. If, at any time, you have any specific questions, feedback, or concerns about the accessibility of any particular portion of the website, please contact us at legal@glossier.com. If you do encounter an accessibility issue, please be sure to specify the Web page/URL in your email, and we will make all reasonable efforts to address your concerns.

      At Glossier, we make products inspired by real life, embracing the ethos of Skin First. Makeup Second™. We believe beauty is about having fun, celebrating freedom, and being present. No matter where you are in your beauty journey, you look good.
